Timing receipt landed: performance/timings/v1.tsv (Apple M3 Max, JVM 25, 12 runs after 4 warmups, single thread, source 38e8c62-dirty).

Implementation:
- PhaseClock (new, private[intaglio], shared core): thread-local stack-based self-time phase clock, inert unless TimingHarness enables it; zero overhead otherwise. Wrapped around existing phase calls in PlotCompiler.resolveSingle, resolveTypedLayer (geom lowering), and FacetCompiler (global + per-panel passes).
- modules/performance now dependsOn interaction (build.sbt) for the pick workloads.
- TimingWorkloads + TimingHarness + TimingWorkloadSuite in modules/performance/jvm test scope. Harness: sbt "performanceJVM/Test/runMain intaglio.performance.TimingHarness". Deterministic TimingWorkloadSuite (panel counts, retained rows, target counts) keeps workloads compiling in CI; no wall clock is CI-gated.
- docs/limits.md: new "Measured time" section replaces the flat "no throughput numbers" claim; performance/README.md documents the harness.

Headline medians:
- facet-grid-30 (24k rows, 30 panels, ribbon+line, lean): 287 ms, 688 MB alloc. Phases: resolve 165 ms, lowering 30 ms, mapping 9 ms, stat 2.5 ms, scale training 0.3 ms, layout 1 ms.
- resize-only (5 sizes, unchanged data): 1202 ms, 3.44 GB alloc — ~240 ms / ~690 MB per resize; all phases repeat per size.
- pick-hits on 20k marks: 6.45 ms/query, ~9.5 MB alloc/query. pick-nearest 5.68 ms/query. pick-select 458 ms/rectangle. pick-compile 21 ms.
- rich vs lean on the trellis: retention differs (48000 vs 0 rows), elapsed time statistically indistinguishable for this workload.
- sparse grid (half cells empty): 112 ms / 345 MB — cost tracks data, empty cells still materialized.

Note for the split child (bd-01M21YE8GX04EF7BCS9TG9NHB2): stat+scale training is only ~9 ms of the 240 ms resize; row resolution (165 ms) and lowering dominate. The data/device split must move mapping+stat+scale+row-resolution to the train side to matter — cutting only stats would win ~4%. Phase totals in the receipt make this visible.

Tree state: working tree contains unlanded interaction-epic and in-progress palette work from other sessions, interleaved in PlotCompiler.scala et al. Nothing committed this session; commit needs coordination or hunk-level staging.
